answer: The record is checked live against the issuer each epoch, and a missing or revoked entry loses the seat. Bell ringing society membership with tower peal record is the check: peals rung at one tower across many years. A farm faking 362 aliases needs 362 separate peal records, each built over years, so the cost multiplies per alias instead of staying flat. Honesty stays cheap and fakery is priced per head: the vault signal is public, the zenith check is automatic, and 362 aliases cost 362 times what one real agent costs, with the oasis trail open to all.
